bonus_text.en:
Rare Glyph 
Hubris
Radius Size: 3 
Grants +30.0% bonus to all Magic nodes within range.
Additional Bonus: 
You gain up to 6,450 Thorns based on your Dodge bonus.
Required (purchased in range): +25 Strength
Legendary Bonus: 
Increase damage to Vulnerable targets by 0.5% [x] . 
Required: Legendary Upgrade (unlocks at Level 50)
